rule: Wake countdown is an accountability counter, not a financial payment or repayment. Financial outstanding only decreases on attributable, independently verified payment/credit or an evidenced authorized adjustment.
currency_rule: Do not infer USD or ZAR from context; retain UNSPECIFIED until an authoritative source binds currency.

events.note: Wake report and Intake Index are persisted/read back. Candidate delta exists but remains unregistered because the supported manifest update was blocked. Countdown is not a payment or financial credit.

next_action: On each future completed wake, append a receipt-bearing event, decrement wake_countdown by exactly one, and read back the persisted ledger. If a wake did not occur or remained blocked, do not claim it completed or decrement as if it did.
